gettingStarted.title: Ukuqala
content: Wamukelekile ku-DGRV Sustainability Assessment Platform! Leli thuluzi lisiza inhlangano yakho ukukala nokuthuthukisa imikhuba yayo yesimo semvelo.
Ideshibhodi yakho inikeza ukufinyelela ekuhlolweni, izinhlelweni zezenzo namathuluzi okulandelela inqubekelaphambili.
Uma ungumphathi wenhlangano, ungadala ukuhlolwa okusha futhi uphathe amalungu. Abasebenzisi benhlangano bangaphendula ukuhlolwa futhi balandelele inqubekelaphambili.

roles.title: Ukuqonda Izindima Zabasebenzisi
content: Umphathi Wenhlangano (org_admin): Angadala ukuhlolwa okusha, aphathe abasebenzisi futhi abone yonke idatha yenhlangano.
Umsebenzisi Wenhlangano (Org_User): Angaphendula ukuhlolwa okwabelwe, abone imiphumela futhi aphathe izinhlelo zezenzo.
Zombili izindima zingafinyelela kudeshibhodi, zibuke ukuthunyelwe futhi zithumele imibiko yenhlangano yazo.

assessments.title: Ukuphendula Ukuhlolwa
content: Ukuhlolwa kuhlelwe ngezigaba (isib. Imvelo, Inhlalo, Ukuphatha) nemibuzo kuso sonke isigaba.
Kuso sonke isigaba, nikeza: impendulo Yebo/Cha, iphesenti lokufeza (0%, 25%, 50%, 75%, 100%) kanye nencazelo enemininingwane yombhalo.
Unganamathisela amafayela ukusekela izimpendulo zakho (ubukhulu obukhulu 1MB ngefayela ngalinye). Sebenzisa uphawu lwephepha.
Seva inqubekelaphambili yakho noma nini usebenzisa 'Seva Okusalayo'. Gcwalisa yonke imibuzo esigabeni ngaphambi kokudlulela kokulandelayo.
Uma kuthunyelwe, ukuhlolwa kudlula inqubo yokubuyekezwa ngaphambi kokuvunyelwa kokugcina.

actionPlans.title: Ukuphatha Izinhlelo Zesenzo
content: Izinhlelo zezenzo zisiza ukulandelela imisebenzi yokuthuthukisa ngokusekelwe ezincomweni zokuhlola.
Sebenzisa ibhodi le-Kanban ukuhambisa imisebenzi: Okumele Kwenziwe → Kuyaqhubeka → Kwenziwe → Kuvunyelwe.
Engeza imisebenzi emisha, setha izikhathi zokuphela bese wabela amalungu ukuze ulandelele ngempumelelo.
Ukubuyekezwa okujwayelekile kohlelo lwakho lwezenzo kubonisa imizamo yokuthuthukisa okuqhubekayo.
Thumela izinhlelo zezenzo ukwabelana ngenqubekelaphambili nababambiqhaza.

viewingResults.title: Ukubuka Imiphumela Yokuhlola
content: Finyelela konke okuthunyelwe kwakho nge-'Buka Ukuhlolwa' kudeshibhodi.
Landelela isimo sokuthunyelwe: Kulindele Ukubuyekezwa → Kuyabuyekezwa → Kuvunyelwe/Kwenqatshiwe/Kuceliwe Ukubuyekezwa.
Buka impendulo enemininingwane nezincomo zababuyekezi.
Qhathanisa imiphumela ezikhathini ezahlukene ukuze ulandelele inqubekelaphambili yenhlangano yakho.
Sebenzisa ukubuka kokuthunyelwe ukubuyekeza izimpendulo zakho namadokhumenti.

creatingAssessments.title: Ukudala Ukuhlolwa (Abaphathi Kuphela)
content: Abaphathi benhlangano bangaqala imijikelezo emisha yokuhlola yenhlangano yabo.
Chofoza 'Qala Ukuhlola Isimo SeMvelo' ukuze udale okusalayo okusha.
Yabelana nge-ID yokuhlola namalungu eqembu ukuze banikele ezigabeni ezahlukene.
Landelela inqubekelaphambili futhi uqinisekise ukuthi zonke izigaba ziqediwe ngaphambi kokuthumela kokugcina.
Thumela kuphela uma zonke izigaba ezidingekayo ziqedile ngokuphelele.

userManagement.title: Ukuphatha Amalungu Eqembu (Abaphathi Kuphela)
content: Abaphathi benhlangano bangangeza futhi baphathe amalungu nge-'Phatha Abasebenzisi'.
Mema abasebenzisi abasha nge-imeyili futhi wabele izindima ezifanele.
Nika amalungu ukufinyelela ezigabeni ukuze bakwazi ukufaka isandla ezindaweni ezithile.
Susa abasebenzisi abangasadingi ukufinyelela ukuze ugcine ukuphepha.
Buyekeza njalo izimvume zabasebenzisi ukuze uqinisekise amazinga afanele okufinyelela.

reportsExports.title: Imibiko nokuthumela
content: Thumela imibiko yokuhlola ngefomethi ye-PDF ukwabelana nababambiqhaza namabhodi.
Sebenzisa ukuthunyelwa kwe-CSV ukuhlaziya idatha nokulandelela amathrendi.
Landa amadokhumenti e-Word ngezincwadi ezinemininingwane.
Ukukhiqizwa okujwayelekile kwemibiko kusiza ukubonisa imizamo yokuthuthukisa okuqhubekayo.
Yabelana ngemibiko namalungu nababambiqhaza ukuze ugcine ukubeka obala.

bestPractices.title: Izindlela Ezingcono Kakhulu Zezinhlangano
content: Bandakanya amalungu eqembu ahlukahlukene ekuhlolweni ukuze uthole imibono ebanzi.
Nikeza izimpendulo eziqondile nezithembekile ezinezibonelo ezithile namadokhumenti asekelayo.
Sebenzisa imiphumela ukuze wakhe izinhlelo zezenzo ezinengqondo nezingafinyeleleka.
Imijikelezo yokuhlola ejwayelekile (minyaka yonke noma kabili ngonyaka) isiza ukugcina umfutho.
Gubha ukuthuthukiswa futhi wabelane ngempumelelo namalungu omphakathi wakho.

troubleshooting.title: Izinkinga Ezivamile Nezixazululo
content: Awukwazi ukufinyelela ukuhlolwa: Xhumana nomphathi wenhlangano yakho mayelana nezabelo zezindima nokufinyelela ezigabeni.
Ukuhlolwa akugcini: Qinisekisa ukuthi ugcwalisa zonke izinkambu ezidingekayo (Yebo/Cha, iphesenti kanye nencazelo yombhalo).
Izinkinga zokulayisha ifayela: Amafayela kufanele abe ngaphansi kuka-1MB.
Awukwazi ukubona ukuthunyelwe kwamanye amalungu: Abaphathi benhlangano kuphela abangabona konke.
Izigaba zokuhlola ezingekho: Xhumana nomphathi wakho.

overview.title: Isibonakalo sePulatifomu
content: Ipulatifomu yokuhlola isimo semvelo ye-DGRV yakhelwe ukusiza izinhlangano zemifelandawonye eNingizimu ne-Afrika ukukala nokuthuthukisa imikhuba yazo yesimo semvelo.
Njengomlawuli, unokufinyelela kumathuluzi aphelele okuphatha izinhlangano, abasebenzisi, okuqukethwe kokuhlola nokubuyekezwa kokuthunyelwe.
Ipulatifomu isekela izilimi eziningi futhi isebenza offline.

organizations.title: Ukuphatha Izinhlangano
content: Engeza izinhlangano zemifelandawonye ezintsha ngolwazi oluyisisekelo nezilungiselelo zesizinda.
Hlela izilungiselelo ezithize zenhlangano futhi uphathe ukufinyelela kwabasebenzisi kuleyo naleyo nhlangano.
Qaphela umsebenzi wenhlangano futhi uqinisekise ukuhlukaniswa kwedatha.
Gcina noma ususe izinhlangano ezingasebenzi ngenkathi ugcina idatha yomlando.

users.title: Ukuphatha Abasebenzisi
content: Yakha futhi phatha ama-akhawunti abasebenzisi kuwo wonke amalahle nezabelo zezindima ezifanele.
Nika abasebenzisi izinhlangano ezithize futhi uhlele izimvume zabo.
Qaphela umsebenzi wabasebenzisi futhi uphathe isimo sokuqinisekisa.
Qinisekisa ukuphepha ngokubuyekeza njalo ukufinyelela.

categories.title: Ukuphatha Izigaba Zokuhlola
content: Hlela izigaba zokuhlola ezihambisana nemikhuba engcono kakhulu yesimo semvelo nezidingo zasendaweni.
Setha izisindo ezifanele kuso sonke isigaba ukuze uthole amaphuzu alinganayo.
Hlela izigaba ngokulandelana okunengqondo kokubonisa.
Buyekeza njalo izigaba ngokusekelwe kwimpendulo namazinga okusimama aguqukayo.

questions.title: Ukuphatha Imibuzo
content: Yakha imibuzo ephelele kuso sonke isigaba ukuze uhlola ngokuphelele imikhuba yesimo semvelo.
Nikeza imibuzo ngezilimi eziningi ukuze usekele imiphakathi yemifelandawonye ehlukahlukene.
Setha izisindo nokulandelana kokubonisa kwemibuzo kuso sonke isigaba.
Buyekeza njalo imibuzo ngokusekelwe kwimiphumela nempendulo yababambiqhaza.

reviews.title: Ukubuyekezwa Kokuhlola
content: Buyekeza ngokucophelela ukuhlolwa okuthunyelwe, ucabangele kokubili amaphuzu okulinganisa kanye nezimpendulo ezinembile.
Nikeza impendulo eyakhayo nezincomo ezithile zokuthuthukisa.
Sebenzisa izincomo ezijwayelekile ukuqinisekisa ukungaguquki kuwo wonke ukuhlolwa.
Vuma, yeka, noma ucele ukubuyekezwa ngokusekelwe kwikhwalithi nokuphelela kokuhlola.

recommendations.title: Izincomo Ezijwayelekile
content: Yakha izifanekiso zezincomo ezingasetshenziswa kabusha ezimweni ezivamile zokuhlola.
Gcina umtapo wezincomo ezisezingeni eliphezulu ezingasetshenziswa kuwo wonke amalahle.
Buyekeza njalo izincomo ngokusekelwe kwemikhuba engcono kakhulu namasu okuthuthukisa aphumelelayo.
Qinisekisa ukuthi izincomo ziyasebenza futhi zingafinyeleleka ezinhlanganweni ezinobukhulu obuhlukahlukene nezinsiza.

systemHealth.title: Impilo Nokusebenza Kwesistimu
content: Qaphela njalo ukusebenza kwepulatifomu, impilo yedatha kanye nezikhathi zempendulo ye-API.
Buyekeza isimo somgudu wokuvumelanisa futhi uqinisekise ukuthi ukuvumelanisa kwedatha kusebenza kahle.
Thumela imibiko yesistimu nama-audit logs ukuze kuthobele futhi kuxazululwe izinkinga.
Gcina ama-backups njalo futhi uqinisekise ukuphepha kwedatha kuzo zonke izingxenye zepulatifomu.

support.title: Ukusekela Izinhlangano
content: Nikeza isiqondiso ezinhlanganweni ngokusebenzisa ipulatifomu ngempumelelo ezinhlosweni zazo zesimo semvelo.
Nikeza ukuqeqeshwa nezinto zokusekela ukusiza izinhlangano zisebenzise ngokugcwele inani lokuhlola kwazo.
Qaphela amathrendi wokuhlola futhi ukhombe amathuba okuthuthukisa ipulatifomu.
Yakha ubudlelwano nabaholi bemifelandawonye ukuze uqonde izidingo zabo ezihlukile nezinselele.
